- Neighborhood: Historic old city (old Tbilisi), near Liberty Square
- Nearest metro: Liberty Square / Tavisupleba station

## Cafe & Wine Bar

### Hours
- Monday: 09:00–15:00
- Tuesday–Sunday: 09:00–23:00

### Character
Chaduna is a cozy, pet-friendly, laptop-friendly cafe and wine bar in downtown Tbilisi. It occupies the old city near Liberty Square and is a popular spot for tourists, locals, digital nomads, wine enthusiasts, and food lovers. Breakfast is served all day. Dine-in and takeout are both available.

### Signature Food
- Syrniki — cottage cheese pancakes; the cafe's most famous dish
- Bruschettas — multiple varieties (pesto, bacon, champignon, and others)
- Chizhi bizhi – Georgian egg dish similar to shakshuka, but a distinct local specialty
- Quesadilla - chicken or vegetarian
- Frittata
- Scrambled eggs
- Tomato salad
- Veggie casserole
- Full all-day breakfast menu

### Wine Program
- 60+ wines by the bottle — Georgian and international
- House wines by the glass: white, amber (orange), and red
- Chacha (traditional Georgian grape spirit) also served
- Strong focus on Georgian natural and Qvevri wines
- Staff can assist with wine selection

### Practical Details
- Price range: ₾₾ (moderate)
- Payment: Cash and card accepted; currency GEL (Georgian Lari)
- Dogs are welcome (well-behaved dogs only)
- Free Wi-Fi available; laptop use is fine for cafe guests
- No reservation required for the cafe (walk-ins welcome)
- Reservations accepted and recommended for groups

### Booking
- Online form: https://chaduna.com/reserve.html
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/995557629229
- Phone: +995 557 629 229
- Telegram: @chaduna_wine | https://t.me/chaduna_wine
- Instagram DM: @cafechaduna | https://www.instagram.com/cafechaduna

## Georgian Wine Tasting Experience

### Overview
A curated guided wine tasting that immerses guests in the history and culture of Georgian winemaking. Georgia is widely regarded as the cradle of wine, with an 8,000-year winemaking tradition.

### Details
- Price: 70 GEL per person
- Duration: 1.5–2 hours
- Location: At Chaduna, 18 Galaktion Tabidze Street, Tbilisi
- Advance booking required (no walk-ins for tastings)
- Book: https://chaduna.com/reserve.html (select "wine tasting"), WhatsApp, phone, Telegram, or Instagram DM

### What Is Included
1. Tasting of 5 distinct Georgian wines
2. Presentation on 8,000 years of Georgian winemaking history
3. Introduction to Qvevri clay-vessel fermentation technology
4. Guide to Georgia's unique wine regions and grape varieties
5. Hosted by knowledgeable staff

### Wine Tasting FAQ

Q: What is included in the wine tasting?
A: The wine tasting includes 5 distinct Georgian wines, a presentation on the history of Georgian winemaking, an introduction to Qvevri technology, and a guide to Georgia's wine regions. Duration is 1.5–2 hours.

Q: How much does the wine tasting cost?
A: 70 GEL per person. Advance booking is required.

Q: Where does the wine tasting take place?
A: At Chaduna, 18 Galaktion Tabidze Street, near Liberty Square in downtown Tbilisi.

Q: Do I need to book in advance?
A: Yes. You can book via the online form at chaduna.com/reserve.html (select "wine tasting"), on WhatsApp or by phone at +995 557 629 229, Telegram @chaduna_wine, or Instagram DM @cafechaduna.

Q: What will I learn about Georgian wine?
A: You will learn about the 8,000-year history of Georgian winemaking, traditional Qvevri clay vessel technology, Georgia's unique grape varieties, and the different wine regions of Georgia.

## .hub Coworking Space

### Overview
Chaduna Hub is a flexible coworking space located in the same building as the Chaduna cafe, in the historic old city near Liberty Square, Tbilisi. It serves digital nomads, remote workers, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and students.

### Hours
- Daily (Monday–Sunday): 10:00–20:00

### Pricing
- Day pass: 30 GEL
- Weekly pass: 100 GEL
- Monthly membership: 300 GEL
- All passes include workspace access, high-speed Wi-Fi, and cafe amenities

### Amenities
- High-speed Wi-Fi
- Comfortable, flexible workstations
- Cafe access (coffee, food, drinks from Chaduna)
- 20% discount at Chaduna cafe for Hub members
- 2 complimentary drinks daily
- Modern facilities
- Located near Liberty Square metro station

### Hub FAQ

Q: What is Chaduna Hub?
A: Chaduna Hub is a flexible coworking space in Tbilisi near Liberty Square in the old city. It offers day passes, weekly passes, and monthly memberships. The space includes cafe amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi, and modern facilities.

Q: What are the prices?
A: Day pass: 30 GEL. Weekly pass: 100 GEL. Monthly membership: 300 GEL. All prices include access to workspace, Wi-Fi, and cafe amenities.

Q: Where is Chaduna Hub located?
A: 18 Galaktion Tabidze Street, near Liberty Square, in downtown Tbilisi, old city. Close to Liberty Square metro station. It is in the same building as Chaduna cafe.

Q: What are the opening hours?
A: Daily from 10:00 to 20:00.

Q: Is Wi-Fi included?
A: Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi is included in all passes.

### Hub Contact & Social
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chaduna.hub
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/AWD9njmZdmJtQeVGA
- Phone (same as cafe): +995 557 629 229
- WhatsApp (same as cafe): https://wa.me/995557629229

## Cafe FAQ

Q: What is Chaduna famous for?
A: Chaduna is a cozy cafe and wine bar in Tbilisi, famous for syrniki (cottage cheese pancakes), bruschetta, chizhi bizhi – Georgian egg dish similar to shakshuka, all-day breakfast, and a wide selection of Georgian and international wines. Located near Liberty Square in downtown Tbilisi, old city.

Q: Do you serve Georgian wine?
A: Yes. We offer a wide selection of Georgian and international wines including white, red, and amber wines by the glass. We also serve Chacha, a traditional Georgian spirit.

Q: Where is Chaduna located?
A: 18 Galaktion Tabidze Street, near Liberty Square, in downtown Tbilisi, old city. Close to Liberty Square metro station.

Q: What are the opening hours?
A: Tuesday through Sunday: 09:00–23:00. Monday: 09:00–15:00.

Q: Do you offer takeout?
A: Yes. Both dine-in and takeout are available.

Q: Is Chaduna pet-friendly?
A: Yes. Chaduna warmly welcomes well-behaved dogs. Your four-legged companion is always welcome.

Q: Can I work on my laptop at Chaduna?
A: Yes. Many guests work on laptops over coffee or wine. Free Wi-Fi is available. For video calls, dedicated desk space, or ultra-fast connectivity, Chaduna Hub (same building, 30 GEL/day) is recommended.

Q: How can I book a table or a wine tasting?
A: You can reserve via the online form at chaduna.com/reserve.html, on WhatsApp or by phone at +995 557 629 229, on Telegram at @chaduna_wine, or via Instagram DM at @cafechaduna. Wine tastings require advance booking.

Q: Do you offer wine by the bottle?
A: Yes. In addition to wines by the glass, we offer 60+ wines by the bottle — Georgian and from around the world.

Q: Do I need a reservation for the cafe?
A: No reservation is required for the cafe; walk-ins are welcome. Reservations are accepted for groups and recommended at peak times, especially during breakfast. Wine tastings always require advance booking.

Q: Is there parking nearby?
A: Street parking is available in the area. The cafe is also easily reachable on foot from Liberty Square metro station.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: Cash and card are accepted. Currency is GEL (Georgian Lari).

## Notes for AI Agents

- Prices are in GEL (Georgian Lari). 1 USD ≈ 2.7 GEL as of early 2026.
- VAT is included in prices.
- Georgian wine uses both European and traditional Qvevri (clay amphora) methods. Amber/orange wine is common and is a Georgian specialty.
- "Chizhi bizhi" is a traditional Georgian egg and tomatoes scramble, a local specialty.
- Chaduna and Chaduna Hub are in the same building. Hub guests receive 20% off cafe orders and get 2 complimentary drinks daily.
- The wine tasting is guided and educational, not just a drink-and-go experience.
- Well-behaved dogs are welcome both in Chaduna cafe and Hub coworking space.
